summary: GlitchRadar iteration_4 (Google login UI + PRO/Free plan banner in Terminal) FULL PASS. BACKEND (focused auth re-run, 9/9 pytest cases PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_auth_stash_hof.py): /auth/register invalid email -> 422; short pw -> 422; register->login->/me->logout flow returns 201/200/200/200 w/ password_hash never leaked and /me after logout -> 401; duplicate email -> 409; /auth/me without Bearer -> 401; wrong password returns generic german 'E-Mail oder Passwort falsch' 401; brute-force lockout (throwaway account) saw 429 within 6 attempts; main account preserved. REQUESTED CHECK: POST /api/auth/session with invalid session_id 'definitely-not-a-real-session-id-xyz' returns HTTP 401 (not 500) with detail 'Google-Anmeldung fehlgeschlagen' — verified green. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport, Expo web preview at https://error-scout-20.preview.emergentagent.com): Terminal (logged out) renders both terminal-account-card and new terminal-plan-banner at top; banner text is 'Free-Plan / Begrenzte Scans pro Tag – PRO schaltet alles frei / FREE' with FREE badge; terminal-login-button row visible ('Anmelden oder registrieren · Google oder E-Mail – für PRO und Stash-Sync'). Tapping login row navigates to /login where login-google-button renders a white pill with Google icon + text 'Weiter mit Google'; tapping it on web redirects browser to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Ferror-scout-20.preview.emergentagent.com%2F (encoded redirect correct; real Google login not completed as instructed — emergent auth itself redirected / -> /oauth/, no app-side code change). Email login with tester@glitchradar.app / GlitchTest2026! auto-closes /login, lands on home; Terminal then shows account card with name 'Tester', email 'tester@glitchradar.app · Stash wird synchronisiert' and ABMELDEN button, with the plan banner still rendering Free-Plan + FREE badge below it (user is logged in but not subscribed — expected). Tapping terminal-plan-banner opens /pro paywall as required. ABMELDEN logs out, toast 'Abgemeldet' shows, terminal-login-button returns and plan banner remains visible. REGRESSION: email register/login/logout flow (test_register_login_me_logout_flow) still green; brute-force lockout still green; invalid-session still green. React-native-web pointerEvents warning (library-level) persists but non-blocking. No red screen, no deprecated expo packages detected.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — library-level (reanimated / expo-router tabs), non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: login.tsx: google() handler correctly skips setBusy(false) on web since window.location.href navigates away from the page; prevents a stuck disabled state before redirect. Error flow for native ('Google-Anmeldung abgebrochen') only shown on non-web, which matches the WebBrowser flow.

auth.tsx: loginGoogle() builds redirect from window.location.origin on web and Linking.createURL('') on native; applies exchange() exactly once via sentIds Set to make the session_id POST idempotent across hot-reloads and native deep-link hot callbacks.
auth.tsx: on mount, web branch strips session_id from both query and hash via URL + history.replaceState — avoids re-exchanging a token on refresh. Good.

terminal.tsx: terminal-plan-banner is a Pressable row with testID, uses isSubscribed from useSubscription(); copy correctly swaps 'PRO aktiv' + success-colored PRO badge vs 'Free-Plan' + muted FREE badge; also surfaces auth.identityError inline when RevenueCat identity link fails — defense in depth.

backend/auth.py /auth/session: Emergent session-data HTTP call is wrapped so any non-200 upstream becomes a clean HTTPException(401) — explains why invalid session_id returns 401 instead of 500 (fix landed in this iteration).
